law006_orientation_array_distinction_law.name: Orientation Array Distinction Law
law006_orientation_array_distinction_law.purpose: Prevent collapse between local orientation operators and distributed orientation topology.

candidate_law_statement.informal: The local orientation operator -(i)_α and the distributed orientation array {-(i)_α} are distinct mathematical objects and must not be collapsed into a single layer.
candidate_law_statement.local_operator_form: -(i)_α := local orientation-conditioned continuation operator at locus α.
candidate_law_statement.array_form: {-(i)_α} := distributed orientation reconciliation topology over local orientation operators.
candidate_law_statement.object_class_distinction: The object -(i)_α and the object {-(i)_α} are not interchangeable: the first is local/operator-like, the second is distributed/topological.
candidate_law_statement.array_not_collection_clause: {-(i)_α} is not treated as a simple unordered collection; it carries relational, topological, recursion-density, and accessibility structure.
candidate_law_statement.transport_relation_clause: NavT acts between local orientation operators, while CSI accessibility and recursion-density structure are properties of the distributed array topology.
candidate_law_statement.operational_distinction: -(i)_α acts locally on continuation and transport; {-(i)_α} governs distributed reconciliation density, accessibility topology, and ordering emergence.
candidate_law_statement.transport_embedding: NavT operates between local -(i)_α operators, while CSI and recursion-density structure emerge from the array topology.
candidate_law_statement.ordering_relation: ordered continuation is generated through distributed admissibility-regulated reconciliation across {-(i)_α}, not from isolated local operators alone.
candidate_law_statement.important_note: This is a foundational object-distinction law, not a proof of physical spacetime emergence or a complete orientation-field theory.
